1. My personal preference is z > x > y > w
2. My priority ranks suggest I'm most competitive at w (rank 1) and y (rank 1)
3. The general applicant trend suggests y is highly desirable
4. Since I have high priority at y and it's a popular school, I want to strategically place it high
5. z is my most preferred school, but I have a lower priority there (rank 2)
